description: This file defines the DashboardPartContentTypeDefinitionHandler class, which manages the registration and configuration of the DashboardPart within content types in OrchardCore, including adding the part to content types with a specific stereotype, marking it as a system part, and creating default definitions if missing.

classes.name: DashboardPartContentTypeDefinitionHandler
classes.description: A handler class that manages the addition and configuration of DashboardPart in content types, ensuring it is added when appropriate, marked as system-defined, and created if missing.

methods.name: ContentTypeBuilding
methods.description: Adds DashboardPart to content type if the stereotype matches 'DashboardWidget' and it is not already added.

methods.name: ContentTypePartBuilding
methods.description: Marks the DashboardPart as a system part to prevent removal.

methods.name: ContentPartBuilding
methods.description: Creates a default ContentPartDefinitionRecord for DashboardPart if it does not exist.

methods.name: ContentPartFieldBuilding
methods.description: Empty method, possibly for future extension.
